input: Brew a first batch of homemade kombucha

gold.taskTitle: Brew Your First Batch of Homemade Kombucha
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to brew their first batch of homemade kombucha from scratch.

questions.title: Do you already have a SCOBY and starter liquid?
questions.description: Determine whether the user needs to source a SCOBY and starter liquid or already has them.

questions.title: What size batch are you planning to brew?
questions.description: Clarify the intended volume, e.g. 1 litre, 1 gallon, to size equipment and ingredient quantities.

questions.title: What type of tea do you want to use?
questions.description: Identify the tea base the user prefers, such as black, green, or white tea.

questions.title: Do you want to do a second fermentation with flavours?
questions.description: Find out if the user wants to carbonate and flavour the kombucha after the first ferment.

questions.title: What brewing equipment do you currently own?
questions.description: Establish what the user already has, such as glass jars, bottles, thermometers, or pH strips.

questions.title: When do you want your first batch ready to drink?
questions.description: Understand the user's target timeline so the plan can work backward from their deadline.

questions.title: Is anyone in your household pregnant or immunocompromised?
questions.description: Check for health considerations that affect safety guidance around raw fermented beverages.
